questions.q: In the comics, why does Scott Lang steal Hank Pym's Ant-Man suit?
options: To save a doctor who could treat his sick daughter
To pay off a debt to a crime boss
To stop Darren Cross from selling it to a foreign army
To get back at Pym for firing him
questions.why: Scott took the suit so he could rescue Dr. Erica Sondheim, the specialist his ill daughter Cassie needed. Pym let him keep it if he used it for good.

questions.q: Scott Lang is a reformed thief and an expert in which field?
questions.why: The comics describe him as a reformed thief and an electronics expert.

questions.q: Which actor plays Scott Lang in the Marvel Cinematic Universe?
questions.why: Paul Rudd has played Scott Lang since Ant-Man (2015) and in later films such as Endgame and Quantumania.

questions.q: Scott Lang's very first appearance, cover-dated March 1979, was in which title?
questions.why: Scott debuted in The Avengers #181 (March 1979); his first outing as Ant-Man followed a month later in Marvel Premiere #47.

options: David Michelinie, Bob Layton and John Byrne
Stan Lee, Larry Lieber and Don Heck
Roy Thomas, John Buscema and Gene Colan
Steve Englehart, Sal Buscema and Len Wein
questions.why: Writer David Michelinie, artist/co-plotter Bob Layton and John Byrne created the second Ant-Man in 1979.

questions.q: In the comics, Scott's helmet lets him communicate crudely with which creatures?
questions.why: His cybernetic helmet allows rough telepathic communication with insects, and also carries sound amplification and a limited air supply.

questions.q: In issue #500 (2004) of the flagship team title, whose explosion at the team mansion seemingly kills Scott Lang?
questions.why: Jack of Hearts blew up at the Mansion during the Avengers Disassembled era, apparently killing Scott until his return in 2011.

questions.q: In Scott's origin, which businessman's company kidnaps Dr. Erica Sondheim?
questions.why: Darren Cross's Cross Technological Enterprises kidnapped Sondheim, which is why Scott stole the Ant-Man suit to save her.

questions.q: After prison, which company hired Scott Lang for its design department?
questions.why: Scott is an electronics expert; after his parole he found work in the design department at Stark International.

questions.q: Who directed Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania (2023)?
questions.why: Peyton Reed directed the third Ant-Man film, Quantumania, released in 2023.
